mnemonic: BUK ~ bukmoq: kitobni bukib qo'yding, demak bu BOOK.
example: I read a book every day. (Men har kuni kitob o'qiyman.)

mnemonic: VOT ER ~ 'Vot, er!': 'Mana, suv!' deb chanqoq odam qichqiradi.
example: Can I have some water? (Menga suv bera olasizmi?)

mnemonic: HAUS ~ 'xush': uyga xush kelibsiz!
example: This is my house. (Bu mening uyim.)

mnemonic: FRI-END: fri (bepul) + end (oxirigacha) - do'st oxirigacha bepul yordam beradi.
example: He is my best friend. (U mening eng yaxshi do'stim.)

mnemonic: BYU-TI-FUL ~ 'Bu tufli': 'Bu tufli chiroyli!'
example: What a beautiful day! (Qanday chiroyli kun!)

mnemonic: RE-MEM-BER: har safar MEM (meme) ko'rsang, eslab qolasan.
example: I remember this song. (Men bu qo'shiqni eslayman.)

mnemonic: WIND + OW: oynani ochsang shamol (wind) kirib, 'Voy!' (ow) deysan.
example: Close the window, please. (Oynani yoping, iltimos.)

mnemonic: TEYBL ~ 'Tayyor bo'l': stolga o'tir, tayyor bo'l!
example: The book is on the table. (Kitob stol ustida.)

mnemonic: DOG ~ dog': dog' tushgan, dog'li it.
example: The dog is barking. (It akillayapti.)

mnemonic: KET ~ ket: mushukka 'Ket!' deb baqiryapsan - bu CAT.
example: The cat sleeps on the sofa. (Mushuk divanda uxlayapti.)

mnemonic: SAN ~ 'sun'iy emas': quyosh sun'iy emas, haqiqiy!
example: The sun is hot today. (Bugun quyosh issiq.)

mnemonic: MUN ~ mungli: oyga qarab mungli bo'lib o'tiribman.
example: The moon is bright tonight. (Bugun kechasi oy yorqin.)

mnemonic: IT ~ eat o'qilishi 'it': 'IT yeydi' - it ovqat yeydi.
example: We eat dinner at seven. (Biz soat yettida kechki ovqat yeymiz.)

mnemonic: LAV ~ lab: sevgi labdan boshlanadi.
example: I love my family. (Men oilamni yaxshi ko'raman.)

mnemonic: S-KUL: maktabda kul (kulgi) ko'p - S + KUL = SCHOOL.
example: The school is near my house. (Maktab uyimning yonida.)

mnemonic: TI-CHER ~ 'Tiy, cher': o'qituvchi 'Tiy, shovqinni tiy!' deydi.
example: Our teacher is very kind. (O'qituvchimiz juda mehribon.)

mnemonic: BIG ~ bek: beklar katta odamlar bo'lgan.
example: This is a big city. (Bu katta shahar.)

mnemonic: ES-MOL ~ small: kichkina mol (buzoq) - SMALL.
example: I have a small room. (Mening kichik xonam bor.)

mnemonic: FAST ~ past: pastga tez yugurdi.
example: He runs very fast. (U juda tez yuguradi.)

mnemonic: HAP-PI: oshni HAP deb yedi va baxtli bo'ldi - HAPPY.
example: I am happy today. (Men bugun baxtliman.)

mnemonic: FAMILY ~ familiya: bir familiyali odamlar - oila.
example: I love my family. (Men oilamni sevaman.)

mnemonic: SITI ~ Sitora: Sitora shaharda yashaydi.
example: Tashkent is a big city. (Toshkent katta shahar.)

mnemonic: MONI ~ Moni: Moni ismli qiz pulni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
example: I need some money. (Menga ozgina pul kerak.)
